test_cases.title: Primary calls to action open their expected destinations

steps.expected: The primary calls to action are available.

test_cases.title: Homepage content and navigation remain usable on mobile

steps.action: Open the homepage in a 390 by 844 mobile viewport.
steps.expected: The mobile layout loads without unintended horizontal overflow.

steps.action: Check the hero text, Emids logo, and primary call to action.

test_cases.title: Empty required contact fields prevent submission

steps.action: Open the contact form with every required field empty.
steps.expected: The contact form is visible and all eight required controls are empty.
Submission triggers validation rather than sending the form.

steps.action: Check each required field's validation feedback.
steps.expected: Every required control is marked invalid and provides its inspected required, email, or phone validation message.

steps.action: Check that the form remains open.
steps.expected: The browser remains on /contact/ and the contact form is still visible.
